steps.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:8085/ and sign in with username admin and password admin. Then find the project named 'Bench Board' and open its board. Report the names of the board's columns in their left-to-right order, exactly as shown on the board page.

recorded.columns: Backlog, Ready, Work in progress, Done

steps.instruction: On the 'Bench Board' project board, create a new task titled exactly '{{runid}} Bench Task' with a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench task for run {{runid}}'). Fill any required fields and submit. Then report the task's numeric ID as displayed (Kanboard shows it as #<number> on the card or task page) and confirm the task appears on the board.

On the 'Bench Board' project board, move the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (task #4) into the '{{01-open.column_work_in_progress}}' column. You can drag the card to that column, or use the task page's move action — whichever works. Do not modify or move any tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:'. Afterwards, verify on the board that the card '{{runid}} Bench Task' is now inside the '{{01-open.column_work_in_progress}}' column and report which column it is in.

Open the task page for task #4 titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' in the 'Bench Board' project. Add a comment to the task whose text includes the runid '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Submit the comment and verify it appears in the task's comments section. Report the comment text that is displayed.

On the task page for task #4 titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' in the 'Bench Board' project, set the task's due date to 2026-12-31 (December 31, 2026). Use the task page's edit/details form or the due-date field (a date picker may appear). Save the change and verify the due date is displayed as 2026-12-31 (or Dec 31, 2026) on the task page. Report the due date value shown.

Do a final verification on the 'Bench Board' project: (1) open the board and report the column names left-to-right and which column contains the card '{{runid}} Bench Task'; (2) open that task's page and report its numeric ID as displayed (the #number), whether its description contains '{{runid}}', whether it has a comment containing '{{runid}}' (quote it), and its due date as displayed. Do not change anything — read only.

recorded.columns: Backlog, Ready, Work in progress, Done
